audit.whatIsWrong: Prose read as a losing lane (whys gave Zaahen levels 2, 3 and first item) while Heimerdinger wins 53.59% over 306 games and the stored chart gave him those rows.
audit.why: Zaahen's Q is a single-target auto-attack modifier and his only AoE approach is Aureate Rush (E) on a 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown — that does not break a two- or three-turret nest for free. Early and mid belong to Heimerdinger; the scaling window belongs to Zaahen.
audit.corrected: whys[1], whys[2] and whys[5] rewritten to Heimerdinger's side, matching the stored chart; row 6 flipped to Zaahen.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had 3 entries instead of 4, and the 2+ item row said Heimerdinger while its own why says Zaahen out-classes the nest.
audit.why: Packet defect list names both. Zaahen's R heals for a portion of damage dealt and his passive lets him revive at full Determination — that is the real late spike and it was nowhere in spikes[].
audit.corrected: Added spikes[3] (sustain/revive spike, anti-heal timing) with before:null; flipped phases[6].side and win[6] to Zaahen as a matched pair with the rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Golden Onslaught" is not an ability in Zaahen's kit, and the Darkin Glaive is described as cleaving turrets when Riot's text has it slashing twice on his next attack (single target, auto reset). Anti-heal and the E's percent-health damage were absent.
audit.why: Kit: Q slashes twice on his next attack and heals, recast knocks up (autoReset, heal). W stab-and-pull, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s. E Aureate Rush dashes and slices around himself, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, percent-health. R Grim Deliverance heals off damage dealt, 110/95/80s. Passive grants AD stacks and a revive at full Determination.
audit.corrected: Aureate Rush (E) named as the gap-closer with its cooldown; Q corrected to a single-target auto reset used as the step-back tell; Oblivion Orb added against Q and R healing; revive added to the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal in itemization despite two healing abilities, and stacking raw armour is the wrong answer into a percent-health E.
audit.why: _missing flags needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb added to report[8].t and to breakdown.mid.

edits.before: Level 2 is Zaahen's: Darkin Glaive cleaves your H-28 turrets down and he walks you down right after — never stand your ground on a dead nest.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours: The Darkin Glaive is a single-target auto reset, so two H-28G turrets out-chip anything he can do without spending his dash.

edits.before: Level 3 stays his — Golden Onslaught engages beat your immobile kit once the nest is thinned.
edits.after: Level 3 stays yours — Aureate Rush (E) is his only way in and it is down 10s, so stun him on the landing.

edits.before: First item is Zaahen's — his sustain out-brawls a peel-less Heimerdinger caught off the nest, and the glaive keeps clearing your setup.
edits.after: First item is yours — Liandry's plus a full nest out-damages his sustain, provided you bought Oblivion Orb and fight on top of the turrets.

edits.before: Glaive clears your turrets, then he walks you down — respect the tempo, re-nest constantly.
edits.after: His Q is single-target; only Aureate Rush reaches the nest, and it is down 10s after he uses it.
Grim Deliverance heals him for a portion of the damage it deals, and a full Determination passive lets him revive — Oblivion Orb before you commit, or you kill him twice and get neither.

edits.before: His Darkin Glaive is the problem: from level 2 it cleaves your turrets down, and once the nest thins his Golden Onslaught walks straight through you. Do not defend dead ground — kite back, re-nest on cooldown, and poke with rockets from behind the next line. Levels 4-5 stabilize because a full nest holds his engage again; your job is keeping it full.
edits.after: The Darkin Glaive is a single-target auto reset, not a cleave — the ability that actually reaches your nest is Aureate Rush (E), and it is down 10s at rank 1. Hold the grenade for his landing, kite back, re-nest on cooldown, and poke with rockets from behind the next line. Levels 4-5 stabilise because a full nest holds his engage again.

edits.before: Level 6 gives you real teeth — an UPGRADE!!! turret plus the grenade stun makes every dive punishable, and a stunned Zaahen inside the nest melts. But first item hands the brawl back to him: his sustain beats a peel-less Heimerdinger anywhere off the setup. Play the tempo game — shove with rockets, take plates while he clears turrets, and never brawl.
edits.after: Level 6 gives you real teeth — an UPGRADE!!! turret plus the grenade stun makes every dive punishable, and a stunned Zaahen inside the nest melts. His Q and his ultimate both heal him, so buy Oblivion Orb before any extended trade or he wins the attrition. Shove with rockets, take plates while he re-approaches, and never brawl off the nest.

edits.before: - Zaahen Ultimate: matchup-defining — His big cooldown. Poke around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - His ultimate: 110s at rank 1 and it heals him off the damage — take the window after it. - Aureate Rush (E): 10s at rank 1, his only way into the nest. - Your grenade: 11s flat, saved for his landing. - UPGRADE!!!: 100/85/70s — kill windows only.

edits.before: His big cooldown. Poke around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 110s at rank 1 and it heals him — engage while it is down, not before.

edits.before: That is Zaahen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His Q is an auto-attack reset — step back on the wind-up, not on the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Full Determination lets him revive — never trade the same kill twice.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's Torment  (turret burn), then Rylai's Crystal Scepter; boots Sorcerer's Shoes.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Liandry's, then Rylai's; boots Sorcerer's Shoes. Oblivion Orb early — his Q and R both heal him.

notes: "Golden Onslaught" does not exist in Zaahen's kit file — replaced with Aureate Rush (E), the dash that matches the described function. Zaahen's W is unnamed in the kit data, so I never named it. spikes[3] was created with before:null to repair the 3-of-4 structural gap; its "when" is First item, which places it after the existing 2+ items entry — if the renderer sorts by array order the user may want the entries reordered by tools, not by me. The prose and the stored chart disagreed on rows 1, 2 and 5; I moved the prose to match the chart and the 53.59% win rate rather than flipping four rows into a chart the win rate contradicts.
